claims.text: How Does the USA Compare on Female Part-Time Work?
Comparing the share of female employment that is part-time across countries and territories using World Bank data.
In the United States, 33.2% of working women are part-time. In the Netherlands, it's 77.3%.
This counts anyone working less than 35 actual weekly hours.
claims.support: Part time employment in this series is based on a common definition of less than 35 actual weekly hours worked.

claims.text: In the Netherlands, short workweeks define daily life for 77.3% of employed women.
Germany also stays high, where 60.6% of women work part-time.
At the other end, Mongolia has 6.2%, the UAE has 5.8%, and Poland is the world's lowest at 0.5%.
